dedupe_keys.name: germany sentinel 2 multi label infrastructure image benchmark

description: This Zenodo benchmark contains 10,000 true-colour Sentinel-2 image chips sampled across Germany to recognise co-occurring infrastructure. Each 224-by-224-pixel image covers about 512 by 512 metres and has independent labels for substations, power plants, storage tanks, major roads and railway features. The public CC BY 4.0 release lists an image ZIP and CSV metadata. OpenStreetMap geometries determined candidate locations and labels; the satellite RGB composites came from Sentinel-2 Level-2A bands. Coverage is a balanced training collection, not a complete geospatial inventory or field-verified asset census. A negative label means none of the selected classes intersects a footprint, not that no built feature exists. Image resolution and OSM completeness limit use for small assets. A reviewer-assessed use is evaluating remote-sensing classifiers before infrastructure exposure modelling. data-openstreetmap is a documented label source, but no up-to-date comparison was performed. No image archive or CSV rows were downloaded. Simulation users would need independent asset verification before treating predicted labels as network inventories.
